association.basis: no source-side evidence within the same scoped AMF-UE-NGAP-ID context satisfies the reviewed association rule

handover_attempts.attempt_id_basis: DERIVED display reference 5gc-ho:<capture>:<association>:<ran-id>:<sequence>; consumers must read the structured source_context/target_context fields, never parse this string

deviations.description: The attempt starts from target-side evidence without an observed HandoverRequired
deviations.limitation: Earlier handover stages may exist outside the capture; no initiation evidence is fabricated

limitations: A procedure-local deviation is protocol evidence; it never attributes blame to any network element, implementation, or radio layer
No source-side handover initiation (HandoverRequired) was observed for this attempt; the capture may begin mid-procedure or the attempt may be target-side only

stages.stage_name: Target resource allocation (HandoverRequest, Acknowledge, or Failure)

limitations: A procedure-local deviation is protocol evidence; it never attributes blame to any network element, implementation, or radio layer
Handover and Path Switch are separate attempt families; neither is required for the other
Source/target association requires the same capture, a scoped AMF-UE-NGAP-ID context, compatible roles, and temporal sanity; timestamp proximity alone never associates anything

N11/N4/N3 supporting evidence is associated only through safe session/tunnel context; an HTTP 2xx or PFCP accepted response never becomes mobility success, and missing N11/N4/N3 evidence never becomes mobility failure
GTP-U observations prove capture-point observation only; tunnel roles stay neutral because reviewed tunnel lifecycle context is not established in this version
Inter-system HandoverTypes are preserved with a scope limitation; no inter-system or 5GS-EPS mobility semantics are applied
This analysis is bounded to the supplied evidence files; absence of evidence is never reported as network absence
